doc: The attract demo's fixtures: power-on recipes (tools/recipes/attract_*.json, fxa_*.json). The pads count frames from fxa_attract_cena_inicial (power-on + 2159 frames under the rule); each was found as the frame whose WRAM is nearest the capture it stands in for (the captures were cut in real time from the owner's snes9x capture, so no frame of the rule's run equals them byte for byte).
